ttl.name: Front Seat Outer Belt Assembly RH

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Door Scuff Plate RH

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 10 claws and remove the front door scuff plate RH.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Front Door Opening Trim Weatherstrip RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the front door opening weatherstrip RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Rear Door Scuff Plate RH

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 8 claws and remove the rear door scuff plate RH.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Rear Door Opening Trim Weatherstrip RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the rear door opening trim weatherstrip RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Lap Belt Outer Anchor Cover

s2.ptxt: Disengage the 3 claws and remove the lap belt outer anchor cover.

s-1.ptxt: Disconnect Front Seat Outer Belt Assembly Floor Anchor

s2.ptxt: Remove the bolt and disconnect the floor anchor portion of the front seat outer belt assembly RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Center Pillar Garnish Lower RH

s2.ptxt: Spread the upper part of the garnish left and right and disengage the 2 claws A.
Pull toward the vehicle inside, disengage the 2 claws B and 2 clips, and remove the center pillar garnish LWR RH.
Using a clip remover, disengage the clip.
Pass the floor anchor portion of the front seat outer belt assembly RH through the center pillar garnish RH and remove the center pillar garnish RH.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Front Seat Outer Belt Assembly RH

s2.ptxt: Remove the nut and disconnect the shoulder anchor of the front seat outer belt assembly RH.
Using a thin-bladed screwdriver with its tip wrapped in protective tape, pull out the locking button toward you, release the lock and disconnect the connector.
Remove the 2 bolts and remove the front seat outer belt assembly RH.
